content: Chloroquine has been observed to increase the toxicity of indapamide through QTc interval prolongation. The clinical significance of this interaction remains uncertain. Chloroquine diminishes the effects of the quadrivalent influenza virus vaccine (intranasal) via pharmacodynamic antagonism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unclear.
